cards.stem: A garage has 5 black cars, 9 red cars and 10 silver cars for sale.

cards.stem: A newspaper report in October 2013 stated that 90% of homeowners who were liable for property tax had registered for it. The total number of properties liable for the tax was estimated at 1·9 million.

cards.stem: A newspaper report in October 2013 stated that 90% of homeowners who were liable for property tax had registered for it. The total number of properties liable for the tax was estimated at 1·9 million. Homeowners, who registered, were required to value their property in one of a number of given Valuation Bands.
